caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a natural light brown finish and visible wood grain patterns. The cabinet consists of two main parts: an upper section and a lower section. The upper section includes two doors with simple rectangular panels and small round knobs, mounted with visible hinges. Below the upper doors are two small horizontal drawers, each with a single round knob. The lower section is slightly wider, featuring two larger doors also with rectangular panels and round knobs, as well as visible hinges. The base of the cabinet has four straight legs, with the front legs featuring a cut-out design at the bottom. The entire cabinet is depicted against a plain off-white background, casting a faint gray shadow to the left and rear. The composition is centered, showing a three-quarter perspective view that reveals the front and left side of the cabinet.
title: Shaker Cupboard
